blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模式的近期进步使得产生越来越现实和互动的虚拟环境成为可能,为玩家定制游戏游戏开辟了新的可能. 代理框架通过将明确的游戏逻辑和可控制的世界表现与视觉一代脱钩来进一步推进这个方向. 然而,现有方法只支持简单的游戏设置和预先定义的运动模式,对看不见的环境和人物的概括性差,提供有限的实时交互. 在本文中,我们介绍了"巫师"(Wizard),这是一个代理游戏世界模式,它能够实时,精确地控制人物动作,同时将零镜头概括到新奇的场景,人物,和行动. 为此,我们构建了一个涵盖750个场景和178个字符的多种数据集,将骨架和几何信息作为结构化的表述。 我们利用这些表示作为中间代词,来附带一个视频生成模型,以及一个适应性的遮罩机制,改善调取信号和产生视频的推出之间的相接性. 此外,我们引入了一种明确维持和更新游戏状态的代理框架,允许玩家自由配置虚拟世界,对角色动作进行精细控制,同时保持视觉质量和游戏播放一致性. 通过将代理控制与结构化的代用生成相结合,我们的框架为玩家驱动的游戏创造提供了新的可能性,具有实时,通俗,机械一致的世界模拟.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models aim to predict future observations from visual histories and current actions, attracting growing interest in gaming applications [ 33 , 2 , 11 , 27 , 10 ] . By conditioning video generation on players’ mouse and keyboard inputs, video world models offer a natural foundation for interactive and personalized gameplay [ 14 , 42 , 48 , 40 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 世界模型旨在预测未来从视觉历史和当前行动进行的观测,吸引对游戏应用的日益关注[33、2、11、27、10]。 通过在玩家的鼠标和键盘输入上调节视频生成,视频世界模型为互动和个性化游戏游戏提供了自然的基础[14,42,48,40,22].

blocks.en: Despite recent progress, existing game world models face limitations in control flexibility, generalization, and real-time interaction. Action-conditioned models [ 38 , 35 , 13 ] typically restrict players to predefined action sets, while prompt-conditioned models [ 49 , 7 , 4 ] often depend on motion and skill patterns seen during training, limiting their ability to follow unseen instructions. To improve state consistency and spatial controllability, recent agentic frameworks maintain explicit world states [ 21 , 7 ] and translate them into structured proxies, such as depth maps [ 28 ] , semantic maps [ 5 ] , blockouts [ 23 ] or oriented 3D bounding boxes [ 15 ] , to guide video generation. However, their demonstrations largely focus on basic movement, such as vehicle driving [ 26 , 18 ] and character locomotion [ 39 , 45 ] , with limited support for articulated character actions. Engine-based approaches [ 16 , 43 ] offer another route to structured control, but their reliance on predefined scenes and extra processing introduces constraints on scene flexibility and interaction latency.
blocks.zh: 尽管最近取得了进展,但现有的游戏世界模型在控制灵活性,通俗化,以及实时互动方面面临限制. 动作有条件的模型[38,35,13]通常限制玩家使用预先定义的动作集,而快速有条件的模型[49,7,4]往往取决于训练期间看到的动作和技能模式,限制了他们遵循未见指示的能力. 为了提高状态一致性和空间可控性,近期的代理框架保持了清晰的世界状态[21,7]并被转化为结构化的代词,如深度地图[28],语义地图[5],阻断[23]或取向的3D边框[15],以引导视频生成. 然而,他们的示威主要侧重于基本运动,例如驾驶车辆[26,18]和性能运动[39,45],对明确的性能行动的支持有限. 基于引擎的方法[16,43]为结构化控制提供了另一种途径,但是它们依赖于预先定义的场景和额外的处理,对场景的灵活性和相互作用的延迟性提出了限制.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce Wizard (Fig. 1 ), an agentic game world model that combines fine-grained character control, zero-shot generalization, real-time interaction and mechanically consistent gameplay , enabling players to customize their game worlds with novel scenes, characters, and motions specified through reference images or free-form language. At its core, Wizard employs an agentic framework to decouple scene construction, character animation, and gameplay logic from visual generation through structured spatial conditioning.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了"巫师"(图1),这是一种代理游戏世界模式,将精细的人物控制,零镜头通俗化,实时互动和机械一致的游戏玩法结合起来,使玩家能够自定义自己的游戏世界,用新奇的场景,人物,动作通过参考图像或自由形式语言来指定. 其核心是"巫师"使用代理框架,通过结构化的空间调节将场景构造,人物动画,游戏游戏逻辑从视觉生成中解开.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of Wizard . Our method supports diverse gameplay experiences, including world exploration, character summoning, character transformation, and scene manipulation. By combining agentic control with geometric scene proxies and articulated character skeletons, Wizard achieves fine-grained control, zero-shot generalization, and mechanics-consistent gameplay with real-time interaction at 24 FPS.
blocks.zh: 图1:巫师概览. 我们的方法支持不同的游戏游戏体验,包括世界探索,角色召唤,角色转换,和场景操纵等. 通过将代理控制与几何场景代言和清晰的人物骨架相融合,"巫师"在24 FPS实现精细分辨控制,零发通化,并实现力学相容的游戏玩法实时互动.

blocks.en: For fine-grained control over camera movement and character animation, our method represents scenes with geometric proxies encoding depth and height, and characters with articulated skeletons. Given any user-provided scene image, we estimate monocular geometry to construct an approximate traversable 2.5D environment and render view-dependent geometric control maps. Character references are converted into 3D meshes and automatically rigged into controllable skeletons, with channel coding distinguishing character instances and their camera-relative orientations. These representations form a unified visual proxy.
blocks.zh: 对于精细地控制相机运动和人物动画,我们的方法代表了几何代号编码深度和高度的场景,以及有清晰骨架的人物. 根据任何用户提供的场景图像,我们估计单相几何,以构建一个近似可穿行的2.5D环境,并制作依赖视图的几何控制图. 字符引用被转换为3D meshes并自动被操纵为可控骨架,其中通道编码区分字符实例及其相机相接取向. 这些表示构成统一的视觉代用.

blocks.en: Building on the unified visual proxy shown in Fig. 1 , the agentic framework then updates scene geometry according to camera inputs and animates character skeletons according to action inputs, providing precise spatial and motion control for the causal video generator. To enable diverse motions for novel characters, a vision-language model retrieves compatible skeletons and animations from a motion library based on character morphology and intended motion style. The selected motions are retargeted to the character’s skeleton, enabling natural movement and player-defined actions. Beyond visual control, the agent further maintains explicit combat states, including health, relative distance, and orientation, to enforce gameplay rules and adapt boss behavior to evolving combat situations.
blocks.zh: 在图1所显示的统一视觉代理的基础上,代理框架再根据相机输入来更新场景几何,而根据动作输入来更新动画字符骨架,为因果视频生成器提供精确的空间和运动控制. 为了能对小说人物进行多样的运动,一个视觉语言模型从一个基于人物形态和意向运动风格的运动库中取回相容的骨架和动画. 选定的运动被重新瞄准角色的骨架,使自然运动和玩家定义的行动成为可能. 超越视觉控制,特工进一步保持了明确的战斗状态,包括健康,相对距离,取向等,以强制执行游戏游戏规则并让上司的行为适应不断变化的战斗情况.

blocks.en: To train the video model to faithfully follow these structured proxies and generalize across scenes, characters, and motions, we construct 50.3 hours of aligned proxy–video pairs from diverse sources, including data specifically designed for skeletal control. We further introduce an adaptive masking mechanism that restricts reference-image attention to the corresponding character regions, strengthening appearance alignment and preserving character identity during motion. Finally, we apply causal adaptation and few-step distillation [ 47 ] to enable real-time video generation, bringing detailed proxy control and consistent visual rendering into an interactive gameplay loop.
blocks.zh: 为了训练视频模型忠实地遵循这些结构化的代名词,并跨场景、人物和运动进行概括,我们从不同来源构建了50.3小时的对等代名词-视频,包括专门为骨骼控制而设计的数据。 我们进一步引入了适应性遮盖机制,限制参考图像对相应字符区域的注意,加强外观相接,在运动时保持字符身份. 最后,我们应用了因果适应和几步分馏[47] 来使实时视频生成成为可能,将详细的代理控制和相容的视觉渲染带入一个交互式游戏游戏循环.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows. • We propose Wizard , an agentic game world model that enables real-time, zero-shot generalization across unseen scenes, characters, and motions with precise control, substantially expanding the possibilities for player-driven game creation. • We build a diverse dataset covering 750 scenes and 178 characters from public videos, game footage, and synthetic sources, with aligned character skeleton and scene geometry to enhance model generalization. • We introduce an agentic video-to-video framework that leverages structured proxies to enable fine-grained player control and mechanics-consistent gameplay. • We leverage the character positions provided by visual proxies during both training and inference to construct adaptive attention masks, improving character identity preservation and alignment between reference images and generated videos.
blocks.zh: · 总而言之,我们的贡献如下。 我们提出"巫师"(Wizard),这是一个代理游戏世界模型,能够实时地,零镜头地跨出不见的场景,人物,动作进行精确的控制,大大地拓展了玩家驱动游戏创造的可能性. ^ 我们建立了一套多样的数据集,涵盖750个场景和178个来自公共视频,游戏镜头,和合成源的人物,并配有对齐的人物骨架和场景几何来增强模型通俗化. •. 我们引入了一种代理视频到视频框架,利用结构化的代理,实现精细的玩家控制和力学相容的游戏玩法. ^ 我们利用在培训和推论期间由视觉代理人提供的人物姿势来构建适应性关注口罩,改善人物身份保存以及参考图像和所生成视频之间的相接.

blocks.en: We propose Wizard , an agentic game world model that enables real-time, zero-shot generalization across unseen scenes, characters, and motions with precise control, substantially expanding the possibilities for player-driven game creation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出"巫师"(Wizard),这是一个代理游戏世界模式,它能够实现实时,零镜头的泛化,跨越不见的场景,人物,动作有精确的控制,大大地扩大了玩家驱动的游戏创造的可能性.

blocks.en: We build a diverse dataset covering 750 scenes and 178 characters from public videos, game footage, and synthetic sources, with aligned character skeleton and scene geometry to enhance model generalization.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一套多样的数据集,涵盖750个场景和178个来自公共视频,游戏片段,和合成源的人物,并配有对齐的角色骨架和场景几何来增强模型通俗化.

blocks.en: We introduce an agentic video-to-video framework that leverages structured proxies to enable fine-grained player control and mechanics-consistent gameplay.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一种代理视频到视频框架,利用结构化的代理,实现精细的玩家控制以及力学相容的游戏游戏.

blocks.en: We leverage the character positions provided by visual proxies during both training and inference to construct adaptive attention masks, improving character identity preservation and alignment between reference images and generated videos.
blocks.zh: 我们利用在培训和推论期间由视觉代理人提供的人物位置来构建适应性关注口罩,改进人物身份的保存以及参考图像和生成的视频之间的相接.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video World Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频世界模式

blocks.en: Recent advances in video generation have enabled action-conditioned world models that allow users to interactively explore generated environments. In games, these models translate keyboard and mouse inputs into dynamic gameplay, with emerging capabilities including NPC control in ReactiveGWM [ 38 ] , fine-grained FPS interactions in SCOPE [ 35 ] , and multiplayer experiences in WorldCast [ 40 ] and Multics [ 14 ] . However, relying primarily on pixel-level supervision makes it difficult to maintain persistent game states, retain long-term history, and preserve spatial consistency [ 15 ] . To address these limitations, agentic frameworks such as WorldMind [ 7 ] and Marionette [ 28 ] decouple explicit state management and gameplay logic from visual generation. Despite these advances, existing methods often remain constrained to the game settings seen during training. In contrast, Wizard combines fine-grained skeletal control with a diverse training dataset to enable zero-shot generalization to unseen scenes, characters, and motions.
blocks.zh: 视频制作方面的最新进展使得有行动条件的世界模型能够让用户互动地探索生成的环境. 在游戏中,这些模型将键盘和鼠标输入转化为动态游戏游戏,其新兴能力包括ReactiveGWM [38]中的NPC控制,SOPE中精细的FPS互动[35],以及世界卡斯特 [40]和Multics [14]中的多人体验. 然而,主要依靠像素级监督使得难以保持持续游戏状态,保留长期历史,并保持空间一致性[15]. 为了解决这些局限性,代理框架如"WorldMind"[7]和"Marionette"[28]将明文状态管理和游戏游戏逻辑与视觉生成脱钩. 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有方法往往仍然受限于训练期间看到的游戏设置。 相形之下,"巫师"将细纹的骨骼控制与多样化的训练数据集结合起来,使"零射"的通俗化能够被无所见的场景,人物,动作所取.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agentic World Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理世界模式

blocks.en: Agentic world models decouple world-state management and action planning from visual generation, enabling explicit control over world dynamics while video models focus on rendering. Related simulation-guided approaches, such as PhysDreamer [ 46 ] , RealWonder [ 24 ] , and RoboRender [ 12 ] , leverage explicit physical dynamics to guide video generation. Moving beyond simulator-defined dynamics, GameDirector [ 21 ] maintains combat states and enforces gameplay rules to support player-configurable game settings, while Code World Model [ 5 ] and Programmable World Model [ 15 ] employ agent-generated programs to maintain persistent world states and guide visual generation through structured proxies. However, these methods primarily emphasize state consistency and entity-level control [ 39 , 45 ] , leaving fine-grained character animation underexplored. Concurrent work, SolarRenderer [ 8 ] , enables real-time video rendering from diverse proxies, yet seamlessly integrating this capability into a closed-loop gameplay experience remains a challenge. To bridge this gap, Wizard extends agentic control to scene geometry and articulated skeletons, enabling flexible scene manipulation and precise character animation. A diverse, multi-source training dataset enhances generalization, while causal adaptation and few-step distillation enable real-time video generation for responsive gameplay.
blocks.zh: 代理世界模型将世界状态管理和行动规划从视觉生成中解开来,使得能够明确控制世界动态,而视频模型则专注于渲染. 相關的模拟-指導方法,如PhysDreamer [46],RealWonder [24],和RoboRender [12]等,能利用明显的物理动态来引导视频生成. 超越模拟器定义的动态,Game Director [21] 维持战斗状态并强制执行游戏游戏规则以支持玩家配置的游戏设置,而代码世界模型[5]和可编程世界模型[15]则使用代理生成的程序来维持持续的世界状态并引导视觉生成通过结构化的代理. 然而,这些方法主要强调状态一致性和实体级控制[39,45],使得精细的人物动画未得到充分探讨. 同时期工作"SolarRenderer [8]",使得来自不同代理的实时视频渲染成为可能,然而将这种能力无缝地融入到闭路游戏体验中仍然是一个挑战. 为了弥补这一缺口,"巫师"将代理控制扩展到了场景几何和被拼接的骨架上,使得能够灵活地进行场景操纵并精确地进行人物动画. 一个多样化的多源培训数据集能增强通俗化,而因果适应和几步分馏则能为应变游戏提供实时视频生成.

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: Training a video world model with fine-grained control and zero-shot generalization requires diverse visual data paired with complementary proxies tailored to characters and backgrounds, namely articulated skeletons for character motion and geometry maps for scene structure. Existing public datasets for video world models either lack these complementary conditions [ 3 , 41 ] or provide them within a single game with limited gameplay diversity [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 训练一个具有精致控制与零镜头通俗化的视频世界模型,需要不同的视觉数据配对,并配有适合人物和背景的互补代词,即用于人物运动的清晰骨架和用于场景结构的几何地图. 现有的视频世界模型公共数据集要么缺乏这些互补条件[3,41],要么在一款游戏中提供有限的游戏游戏多样性[19].

blocks.en: To this end, we construct 50.3 hours of aligned proxy–video pairs , covering 750 scenes and 178 characters across diverse environments, character morphologies, and motion patterns. Our dataset combines real gameplay recordings, synthetic data, Unreal Engine simulations, and public datasets to achieve broad coverage of scenes, characters, and motions while supporting scalable data production and high visual quality (Sec. 3.1 ). All sources are converted into a unified representation of scene geometry and articulated character skeletons, enabling the video generator to learn consistent control across different scenes and characters (Sec. 3.2 ). Fig. 2 illustrates the dataset composition, diversity and processing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们构建了50.3小时的对齐代理-视频对接,覆盖了750个场景和178个角色,它们跨越了不同的环境、性格形态和运动模式。 我们的数据集结合了真实的游戏机录音,合成数据,不真实引擎模拟,以及公共数据集,实现对场景,人物,动作的广泛覆盖,同时支持可扩展的数据制作和高可视质量(Sec. 3.1. 所有来源被转换为场景几何和清晰的人物骨架的统一代表,使视频生成器能够学习不同场景和人物的一致控制(Sec. 3.2. 图2说明了数据集的组成、多样性和处理管道。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Dataset Overview and Processing Pipeline. We construct 50.3 hours of data spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters from four complementary sources. Scene geometry and character skeletons are jointly encoded into unified visual proxies, followed by filtering and captioning to produce aligned proxy–video training pairs.
blocks.zh: 图2:数据集概况和处理管道. 我们从四个互补来源构建了50.3小时的数据,涉及750个场景和178个字符。 场景几何和人物骨架被联合编码为统一的视觉代名词,再进行过滤和字幕来制作相配的代理-视频训练对.

blocks.en: 3.1 Diverse Data Sources
blocks.zh: 3.1 各种数据来源

blocks.en: We collect 8.8 hours of third-person combat and exploration footage from Elden Ring [ 9 ] to capture authentic AAA-game appearance, combat dynamics, and visual effects. Combat sequences feature six bosses with diverse body structures, capturing articulated attacks, hit reactions, and combat effects. Exploration sequences span 11 regions and more than 20 player outfits, covering varied environments, camera trajectories, and character locomotion. We record RGB frames alongside camera parameters, scene depth, and character skeletons directly from the game, ensuring accurate temporal alignment between visual observations and control signals.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了来自埃尔登环 [9] 的8.8小时第三人称战斗和探索镜头,以获取真实的AAA-游戏外观,战斗动态,和视觉效果. 战斗序列的特征是6个有不同身体结构的上司,捕捉出清晰的攻击,命中反应,以及战斗效果. 探索序列跨出11个区域和20多套玩家服装,涵盖各种环境,相机轨迹,和人物运动. 我们直接从游戏中记录了相机参数,场景深度和人物骨架的RGB帧,确保了视觉观测与控制信号之间的准确时间对接.

blocks.en: While gameplay recordings provide realistic visual dynamics, their character appearances, motion patterns, and interactions remain constrained by the original games. To broaden this coverage, we develop a procedural rendering pipeline that generates 11.6 hours of data using 133 boss and 29 player assets from Sketchfab [ 32 ] , Quaternius [ 30 ] , and KayKit [ 25 ] , with diverse skeletons and animation libraries. We construct varied environments using 842 Poly Haven [ 29 ] assets, populate each scene with 15–30 randomly placed props, and randomize character colors, enabling scalable generation of diverse character–scene combinations. Beyond appearance diversity, we design four scenarios to strengthen control robustness: (i) novel-character entry; (ii) multi-character coexistence; (iii) camera-induced disappearance and reappearance; and (iv) rapid turns under a following camera. These scenarios encourage the model to associate each character with its corresponding skeleton and reference image, rather than a fixed appearance or screen position. Camera motion is applied to 95% of generated samples to further diversify viewpoints. Finally, we use a vision-language model to filter out invalid renders and physically implausible placements to ensure data quality.
blocks.zh: 虽然游戏剧情录音提供了现实的视觉动态,但其角色外观,运动模式,和互动仍然受到原作游戏的限制. 为了扩大这一覆盖范围,我们开发了程序渲染管道,利用133个上司和29个玩家资产从Sketchfab[32],Quaternius [30],和KayKit[25]获得11.6小时的数据,并有多种骨架和动画库. 我们利用842 PolyHaven [29] 资产构建了不同的环境,每个场景都配有15-30个随机放置道具,随机配置字符颜色,从而能够形成可扩展的多种字符组合。 除了外观多样性外,我们设计了四种情景,以加强控制稳健性:(一) 新式特征的输入;(二) 多式特征的共存;(三) 相机引起的消失和再现;以及(四) 以下相机下的快转. 这些情景鼓励模型将每个字符与其相应的骨架和参考图像联系起来,而不是固定外观或屏幕位置. 相机运动适用于95%的生成样品,以进一步使观点多样化. 最后,我们使用一种视觉语言模式过滤出无效的和物理上不可信的位置,以确保数据质量。

blocks.en: Furthermore, we use Unreal Engine to generate 3.3 hours of gameplay footage featuring reconstructed characters and weapons [ 34 ] , scripted opponents, and bot-controlled players. Rendering RGB frames and geometric proxies from the same simulated state ensures precise alignment, while configurable scenes enable scalable collection of varied combat interactions and camera viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们使用"不真实引擎"(Unreal Engine),生成3.3小时的游戏剧情片段,以重塑角色和武器为主角[34],剧本对手和机器人所控制的玩家. 从同一种模拟状态来渲染RGB帧和几何代号可以确保精确的对齐,而可配置的场景则能够可扩展地收集出各种战斗相互作用和相机视角.

blocks.en: We incorporate 26.6 hours of high-quality gameplay footage from WildWorld [ 19 ] , complementing our collected data with diverse creature morphologies and motion patterns. Its synchronized camera, skeletal, and depth annotations are converted into our unified proxy representation, preserving control–video alignment while broadening the coverage of articulated interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们加入了来自WildWorld [19]的26.6小时高品质的游戏片段,以不同的生物形态和运动模式来补充我们收集的数据. 它的同步相机,骨骼和深度说明被转换成我们的统一的代理代表,保持控制-视频对接,同时扩大清晰互动的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Processing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集处理管道

blocks.en: We first obtain camera parameters, character skeletons, and scene depth for each video to construct proxies aligned with the video frames. For real gameplay, we extract camera poses, intrinsics, and skeletal states directly from the game process. We also capture scene depth at one frame per second and use it to reconstruct scene geometry, from which depth maps are rendered at each frame’s camera pose. For synthetic and Unreal Engine data, we obtain these quantities directly from the underlying assets and simulation states. For public datasets, we use the provided annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们首先获得相机参数,人物骨架,以及每个视频的场景深度,以构建与视频帧一致的代词. 对于真正的游戏游戏,我们直接从游戏过程中取出相机姿势,内在和骨骼状态. 我们还以每秒一帧的速度捕捉场景深度,并用它来重建场景几何,从中,每个场景相机的相机姿势都会提供深度地图. 对于合成和不真实的引擎数据,我们直接从基础资产和模拟状态获得这些数量. 对于公共数据集,我们使用所提供的说明。

blocks.en: We construct a unified geometric conditioning video that represents character poses and scene structure under a shared camera. At each frame, character skeletons and scene geometry are jointly rendered to preserve their spatial relationships and mutual occlusion. For the scene branch, we remove characters and sky from depth maps, fuse temporally neighboring observations into 3D scene geometry, and re-render it under each frame’s camera pose. For the character branch, we project 3D joints into the camera view and render bones as rounded segments with joint markers, adapting their thickness to character scale and camera distance. Following the geometric channel encoding of Marionette [ 28 ] , the RGB channels represent geometric attributes rather than appearance colors. R \mathrm{R} encodes height, with character and scene values mapped to [ 0 , 0.2 ] [0,0.2] and [ 0.5 , 1 ] [0.5,1] , respectively, while B \mathrm{B} encodes camera-forward depth, with brighter values indicating closer surfaces. At each pixel, the renderer retains the surface closest to the camera.
blocks.zh: 我们构建一个统一的几何调值视频,在共享相机下代表人物姿势和场景结构. 在每个相框上,人物骨架和场景几何被联合渲染,以保持其空间关系和相互隔离. 对于场景分支,我们将角色和天空从深度图中去除,将相邻时间观测线导入3D场景几何,并在每个相框相机姿势下重新交接. 对于角色分支,我们将3D关节投射入相机视图并用相机标记将骨骼做成圆形片段,使其厚度适应角色尺度和相机距离. 沿着马里奥内特的几何通道编码 [28],RGB通道代表几何属性而非外观颜色. R\mathrm{R}编码了高度,字符和场景值分别被映射到[0,0.2] [0,0.2]和[0.5,1] [0.5,1],而B\mathrm{B}编码了相机前向深度,更亮的值显示更接近表面. 在每个像素上,渲染器保留最接近相机的表面.

blocks.en: To support reference-conditioned character control, we use G \mathrm{G} to jointly encode a character’s slot and facing direction, while assigning scene geometry G = 0 \mathrm{G}=0 . All parts of a character share the same value within each frame, and the facing component helps distinguish otherwise similar front- and back-facing skeletal configurations. Slots are assigned to the player and bosses present in the current scene, with each slot linked to its corresponding reference image. This scene-specific assignment decouples slot codes from fixed character appearances, encouraging the generator to recover appearance from the associated references and supporting generalization to unseen characters.
blocks.zh: 为了支持有参考条件的字符控制,我们使用 G\ mathrm{ G} 联合编码字符槽和正向方向, 同时分配 s景几何 G = 0\ mathrm{ G}=0 。 一个字符的所有部分在每一个帧内都具有相同的值,而面相组件有助于区分本来类似的前相和后相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 槽被分配到当前场景中在场的玩家和上司,每个槽都与其相应的参考图像相链接. 这个场景特异性的任务从固定字符外观去除槽码,鼓励生成者从相关引用中恢复外观,支持将外观归纳为隐形字符.

blocks.en: We filter out synthetic samples with implausible configurations, such as floating players, or rendering failures. For each training sample, we use Qwen3-VL-8B [ 1 ] to generate structured captions from the first frame and character references, describing the conditioning signals, player, boss, and background. Each training sample consists of an aligned proxy video, an RGB clip, character reference images, and a textual description.
blocks.zh: 我们过滤出合成样品,其配置不可信,例如浮动玩家,或者渲染失败. 对于每个训练样本,我们使用Qune3-VL-8B [1] 从第一个帧和字符引用生成结构化字幕,描述调制信号,玩家,上司,以及背景. 每个培训样本包括一个对齐的代理视频,一个RGB剪辑,字符参考图像,以及文字描述.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 3 , Wizard combines an agentic framework for explicit world-state control with a video generator that renders the evolving state through structured visual proxies. Before each gameplay session, an initialization stage taking less than five minutes reconstructs the scene and characters, rigs character skeletons, and builds a target-specific motion set through motion retrieval and retargeting. Once initialized, the framework supports real-time gameplay by updating character motions, scene geometry, and combat states in response to player inputs and boss decisions, while the video generator renders the corresponding visual observations. We first describe the agentic framework for character animation, scene manipulation, boss control and mechanics-consistent combat (Sec. 4.1 ), then introduce character-aware adaptive masking and the training pipeline for real-time video generation (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 如图所出. 3,"巫师"将明确世界状态控制的代理框架与视频生成器相结合,通过结构化的视觉代理使正在演变的状态. 在每场游戏会话前,一个初始化阶段用不到五分钟的时间重建场景和人物,钻机人物骨架,并通过运动取回和再瞄准来构建出特定目标运动. 初始化后,框架通过更新角色动作,场景几何,以及战斗状态来响应玩家的输入和上司的决定,支持实时游戏播放,而视频生成器则做出相应的视觉观察. 我们首先描述了角色动画,场景操纵,老板控制和力学相容的战斗的代理框架(Sec 4.1),然后引入了角色意识适应性面具和实时视频生成的培训管道(Sec 4.2).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Inference Pipeline of Wizard. (a) Character animation is driven by motions retrieved from a high-quality library and retargeted from compatible source skeletons to the target character’s skeleton. (b) Scene manipulation is performed by a world agent that edits 3D scene geometry and renders visual proxies using OpenGL. (c) State-aware combat control adapts boss behavior to the current game state and enforces rule-based combat mechanics. (d) Real-time video generation is conditioned on visual proxies, reference images, and previously generated frames.
blocks.zh: 图3:向导的推论管道。 (a) 人物动画是由从高质量库取回的动作驱动的,并且从相容源骨架被重新瞄准目标人物骨架。 (b) 场景操纵由一个世界代理机构进行,该代理机构会编辑3D场景几何并使用OpenGL制作视觉代理. (c) 国家意识的战斗控制使上司行为适应目前的游戏状态并强制执行以规则为基础的战斗力学。 (d) 实时视频生成以视觉代理、参考图像和以前产生的帧为条件。

blocks.en: 4.1 Agentic Framework
blocks.zh: 4.1 代理框架

blocks.en: Given a user-provided character image, Qwen3-VL [ 1 ] detects characters and infers their body structures, including posture (upright or horizontal), the number and arrangement of legs, arms, wings, tails, and heads, and their anatomical left–right assignments. We use the predicted bounding boxes to guide SAM2 [ 31 ] in segmenting each character, then reconstruct its mesh with TripoSG [ 17 ] . UniRig [ 44 ] and our medial-axis fitting procedure generate candidate skeletons, from which we select the one that best matches the inferred body structure. We assign semantic labels to its joints and limb chains, identifying body parts such as the left arm or right leg. These labels allow corresponding body parts to be matched across characters with different joint counts and proportions, providing a shared interface for motion retargeting and control.
blocks.zh: 鉴于用户提供的字符图像,Qune3-VL [1] 检测出字符并推断出其身体结构,包括姿势(正向或水平),腿,手臂,翅膀,尾翼和头部的数量和排列,以及解剖的左-右任务. 我们使用预想的边框来引导 SAM2 [31] 切分每个字符,然后用 TripoSG [17] 重建它的网格. UniRig [44] 和我们的中轴相配程序产生候选骨架,我们从中选择最适合所推断出的身体结构的骨架. 我们给它的关节和四肢链划上语义标签,识别出左臂或右腿等身体部位. 这些标签允许对应的身体部分在字符之间相匹配,具有不同的联合计数和比例,为运动重定向和控制提供了共享接口.

blocks.en: To enable realistic combat movements for novel characters, we build a reference motion library from CombatMotion [ 20 ] , WildWorld [ 19 ] , and animation assets from Elden Ring [ 9 ] . For each target character, we retrieve motions from source skeletons with compatible body structures and use a VLM to assess whether the source characters’ movement styles, such as aggression, grace, or power, suit the target’s appearance. The selected motions can come from multiple sources, allowing each target to inherit a varied moveset. We retarget these motions by matching corresponding limb chains, adapting motion to the target’s limb lengths, and applying inverse kinematics to maintain ground contact. We then filter out clips with poor ground contact, body penetration, or unnatural limb crossing. The remaining clips form a motion library tailored to the target character, enabling the controller to retrieve and execute motions in real time without custom animation scripts.
blocks.zh: 为了让小说角色能够进行现实的战斗运动,我们从"战斗运动"[20],"荒野世界"[19],以及从"埃尔登环"[9]获得的动画资产建立一个参考运动库. 对于每个目标字符,我们从具有相容体结构的源骨架上取出运动,并使用VLM来评估源字符的运动风格,如攻击,优雅,或力量,是否适合目标外观. 所选的运动可以来自多个来源,允许每个目标继承一个不同的移动集. 我们通过匹配相应的肢链来重新瞄准这些运动,使运动适应目标肢长,并应用逆动能来保持地面接触. 然后过滤出地面接触不良的片段, 身体穿透,或者非自然的肢体穿行。 所剩片段组成了适合目标字符的动作库,使控制器能够在没有自定义动画脚本的情况下实时取出并执行动作.

blocks.en: As with character control, users can customize and manipulate scenes according to their preferences. Given a scene image, we use MoGe-2 [ 37 ] to recover a 3D point map and camera parameters, remove character regions, and construct a background mesh supplemented by a height field. An OpenGL-based offscreen renderer, implemented with ModernGL and EGL, renders this geometry from the current camera viewpoint using the same proxy encoding as in training: the R and B channels encode world height and inverse depth, respectively, while the G channel is set to zero. As the camera moves, the world agent re-renders the persistent scene geometry to produce a spatially consistent visual proxy. To support exploration beyond the input view, the agent extends the height field with smoothly blended terrain variations based on the observed scene’s roughness.
blocks.zh: 和角色控制一样,用户可以根据自己的偏好定制和操纵场景. 鉴于一个场景图像,我们使用 MoGe-2 [37] 来取回一个三维点地图和相机参数,去掉字符区域,并构造一个背景网由高地来补充. 一个基于OpenGL的外屏幕渲染器,由ModernGL和EGL执行,使用与训练时相同的代理编码从当前相机角度使这个几何化:R和B频道分别编码了世界高度和反深度,而G频道被设定为零. 随着相机的移动,世界代理重新将恒定场景几何重置,以产生空间相通的视觉代用. 为了支持超出输入视图的探索,代理人根据所观测到的场景的粗糙程度,将高地以平稳地混合地形变化来延伸.

blocks.en: During gameplay, the world agent, powered by Qwen3-VL-8B, translates users’ natural-language instructions into executable programs that compose predefined geometric operators and specify their locations, scales, and deformation parameters. These programs modify the underlying scene geometry, enabling transformations such as raising a platform from the ground or turning the world upside down. The modified geometry is then re-rendered into the proxy video, supporting creative, interactive scene manipulation while maintaining consistent camera projection and spatial structure.
blocks.zh: 在游戏播放期间,由Quen3-VL-8B提供动力的世界代理将用户的自然语言指令翻译为可执行的程序,这些程序由预定义的几何操作符组成并指定其位置,尺度,和变形参数. 这些方案修改了基础场景几何,使得诸如从地上提升出一个平台或者使世界颠倒等转变成为可能. 修改后几何再被重新送入代理视频,支持创造性,互动性的场景操纵,同时保持相机投影和空间结构的一致性.

blocks.en: Our framework maintains a shared world state that tracks both characters’ positions, poses, health, action phases, and skill cooldowns. Based on this state, a behavior planner selects movements and attacks from the previously constructed target-specific motion set. When the player is out of reach, the planner selects a motion that moves the boss toward the player. Within attack range, it evaluates candidate attacks by simulating their swings against the player’s current geometry and prioritizes those likely to connect, subject to action-phase and cooldown constraints. This state-aware planning enables the boss to respond to the player’s movements and the evolving combat situation.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架维持一个共同的世界状态,跟踪两个角色的地位、姿势、健康、行动阶段和技能的冷却。 基于这个状态,一个行为规划师从之前构建的目标特定运动集中选择了动作和攻击. 当玩家无法到达时,计划者会选择一个将老板向玩家移动的运动. 在攻击范围内,它通过模拟其与玩家当前几何的相撞来评价候选攻击,并在行动阶段和冷却限制下,优先考虑那些可能连接的人. 这种国家意识的规划使上司能够对玩家的动作和不断变化的战斗情况作出反应.

blocks.en: The selected motion is then executed in the simulation, where a rule-based controller enforces gameplay constraints and resolves combat outcomes for both characters. It detects hits by checking each attack’s swept hitbox against the target’s geometry while accounting for invulnerability windows. Valid hits reduce the target’s health, update its health bar, and trigger hit reactions. Skills become available only after their cooldowns expire, and combat ends when either character’s health reaches zero. The updated world state informs the planner’s next decision and is rendered into visual proxies that condition the video generator. Together, state-aware planning and rule-based execution support responsive, mechanics-consistent combat independently of video generation.
blocks.zh: 然后在模拟中执行所选择的动作,一个基于规则的控制器执行游戏游戏限制,并解决两个字符的战斗结果. 它通过检查每起攻击的被扫射出的攻击箱与目标几何特征进行检测,同时考虑不可侵犯的窗口. 有效的打击会降低目标的健康, 更新其健康栏, 只有在他们的冷却期已过后,才能获得技能,当两个角色的健康达到零时,战斗才结束。 最新世界状态为规划者的下个决定提供参考, 国家意识规划和以规则为基础的执行共同支持响应性,力学相适应的战斗,独立于视频生成.

blocks.en: 4.2 Model Training
blocks.zh: 4.2 示范培训

We build our video generator on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 36 ] ,

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 4 , the first frame is encoded as a clean latent prefix to establish scene appearance. Proxy frames are encoded by the same VAE and concatenated with noisy video latents along channels, using a zero-initialized condition embedding to introduce spatial control while preserving the pretrained model’s initial behavior.
Character references are appended as additional tokens to specify appearance. We bind these references to their corresponding characters through adaptive attention masking, then distill the conditioned generator for real-time autoregressive inference.
blocks.zh:
如图4所显示,第一个框架被编码为一个干净的潜伏前缀来建立场景外观. 代理帧由同一种VAE编码,并沿频道用吵闹的视频潜伏相接而成,使用零初始化条件嵌入引入空间控制,同时保留被预先训练的模型的初始行为.
字符引用作为指定外观的附加符号被附上. 通过适应性注意蒙面,我们把这些参考物绑在相应的字符上,然后将条件化的生成器蒸馏出来,用于实时自递性推断.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Video Generator Architecture and Character-Aware Adaptive Masking. (a) Visual proxy latents are concatenated with noisy video latents along channels, then combined with first-frame and character-reference tokens along the sequence dimension for DiT processing. (b) Skeleton-derived spatial masks restrict reference attention to the corresponding character regions, binding appearance guidance to character locations.
blocks.zh: 图4:视频生成器架构和字符感知适应性面具. (a) 视觉代用潜伏物由各频道有噪音的视频潜伏物相接而成,然后与一帧和字符参照符号相接,沿DiT处理的序列维相接。 (b) Skeleton衍生的空间口罩限制了对相应字符区域的参考注意,将外观指导绑定在字符位置上。

blocks.en:
Character skeletons provide explicit spatial information during both training and inference: training data include ground-truth skeletons, while our agentic framework maintains and updates them at runtime. We leverage this shared structure to bind each reference image to its intended character. Each character reference image is VAE-encoded and appended as tokens with a distinct temporal positional offset. For each frame, we derive a bounding region from each character’s skeleton and expand it by 25% to include the character and its surrounding context. blocks.en: These spatial masks are updated from the explicit character states maintained by our agentic framework, allowing players to control when and where bosses appear or disappear while directing reference guidance to the corresponding regions. As characters move, the masks follow their positions, reducing cross-character appearance leakage. During character transformation, we additionally block attention to cached tokens associated with the previous identity while preserving access to background history and the first-frame sink. By linking appearance guidance to agent-controlled character states, this strategy supports flexible summoning, removal, transformation, and multi-character gameplay while maintaining scene continuity.
blocks.zh: 这些空间口罩是从我们代理框架所保持的显性状态来更新的,允许玩家控制老板出现或消失的时间和地点,同时引导参考指导到相应的区域. 随着人物的移动,口罩会跟随自己的位置,减少跨特征外观的渗出. 在字符转换过程中,我们额外地阻断了对与上个身份相关的缓存符的注意,同时保留了对背景历史和第一帧槽的获取. 通过将外观指导与代理控制的角色状态相链接,这一策略支持灵活的召唤,去除,转换,以及多特征的游戏游戏,同时保持场景连续性.

blocks.en: Following Causal Forcing++ [ 47 ] , we adopt a three-stage training pipeline for real-time autoregressive generation. First, we adapt the bidirectional model to autoregressive generation through teacher forcing. Second, we perform consistency distillation with a guided causal teacher and an exponential moving average (EMA) target, training the student with a sliding window of 20 latent frames and the first frame as a persistent attention sink. Third, we apply distribution matching distillation (DMD) to the student’s own autoregressive rollouts, using the frozen bidirectional model as the target score network and a learned critic to estimate the student’s score. Our visual proxy conditions and character-gated reference attention remain active throughout all three stages, preserving spatial and appearance control during adaptation and distillation. The resulting model generates real-time rollouts at 24 FPS with only 2 denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 继Causal Forcing++ [47]后,我们采用三级训练管道进行实时自转生成. 首先,我们通过教师的强迫,使双向模式适应自相递进的生成. 第二,我们与导引因果师和指数移动平均值(EMA)进行一致性分解,对学生进行由20个潜在框架和第一个框架组成的滑动窗口培训,作为持续关注的沉淀。 第三,我们把分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)应用于学生自身的自相递减推出,使用被冻结的双向模式作为目标分数网络和一个有学问的批评家来估计学生分数. 我们的视觉代理条件和人物参考关注在所有三个阶段都依然活跃,在适应和蒸馏过程中保持空间和外观控制。 由此产生的模型以24个FPS产生实时推出,只有2个去名步骤.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We partition the aligned RGB and proxy sequences into non-overlapping windows of 121 frames at 30 fps, each spanning approximately four seconds. Frames are resized to a height of 480 pixels and center-cropped to 832 × 480 832\times 480 , with identical transformations applied to both modalities to preserve spatial alignment. Character reference images are resized to 480 × 480 480\times 480 . For efficient training, we pre-encode the RGB and proxy clips using the Wan2.2 VAE, yielding latent representations with 31 temporal steps and a spatial resolution of 30 × 52 30\times 52 .
blocks.zh: 我们把对齐的 RGB 和 代理序列分割成 121 帧的不重叠窗口 在 30 fps 上, 每一帧的长度大约为 四秒。 框架被调整为480像素的高度,而中克被调整为832×480 832\times 480,两种模式都应用了相同的转换来保持空间相通. 字符参考图像被调整为480×480\times 480. 为了有效培训,我们使用Wan2.2 VAE预编码RGB和代理剪辑,产生31个时间步骤的潜在表示,空间分辨率为30×52 30\时52分。

blocks.en: We initialize our model from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 36 ] , keeping its VAE and UMT5 text encoder [ 6 ] frozen. We train on 44,075 clips, paired with geometry-and-skeleton conditions, a text description, and up to two character appearance references. Training comprises 30K steps of bidirectional fine-tuning, 10K steps of causal adaptation, and subsequent distillation for efficient inference. We deploy the student’s exponential moving average (EMA) checkpoint after 500 distillation steps. At inference, the model uses two denoising steps and a KV cache that retains 20 recent latent frames and one persistent sink frame, enabling continuous, bounded-memory streaming for real-time interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们从Wan2.2-TI2V-5B[36]初始化我们的模型,保持其VAE和UMT5文本编码器[6]被冻结. 我们用44,075个片段训练, 配对几何和斯凯莱通条件, 一个文本描述, 最多两个字符外观参考。 培训包括双向微调的30K个步骤、因果调整的10K个步骤以及随后为有效推论而提炼。 校对:Soup 推论,该模型使用了两个去诺化步骤和一个KV缓存,保留了20个最近的潜入框架和一个持久的汇出框架,使得连续的,有界的相流能够进行实时交互.

blocks.en: We qualitatively evaluate Wizard’s zero-shot generalization in Fig. 5 and its support for open-ended creative gameplay in Fig. 6 . Each example presents user-provided scene or character references on the left, followed by paired agent-controlled visual proxies and generated gameplay frames on the right. The references are unseen during training, and all examples use the same trained model without additional fine-tuning. This presentation allows direct inspection of how user inputs are translated into structured controls and reflected in the generated videos.
blocks.zh: 我们从质量上评价了Wizard在图5中的"零镜头"概括,以及它对在图5中进行开放式创意游戏的支持. 6 (英语). 每个实例都给出了用户提供的场景或左边的字符引用,然后是成对的代理控制的视觉代理并生成了右边的游戏玩框. 在培训期间,参考文献是看不见的,所有实例都使用同样的训练有素的模型,而没有进行额外的微调。 这一演示可以直接检查用户输入如何被转化为结构化的控制并反映在生成的视频中.

blocks.en: 5.2 Zero-shot Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.2 零发

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 5 (a), Wizard generalizes to novel scenes, characters, and motions. Given user-provided inputs, the agent controls visual proxies to generate real-time combat rollouts that follow the specified scene structure and character motions. The paired visualizations show how character poses and spatial arrangements in the proxies are reflected in the generated frames, while reference images specify the desired appearance. These examples illustrate the model’s ability to accommodate new combinations of environments, character appearances, and motion controls without additional training. Diverse training data and character-aware adaptive masking support visual consistency throughout the rollouts.
blocks.zh: 如图5(a)所显示,"巫师"对小说场景,人物,动作进行概括. 鉴于用户提供的投入,代理控制可视代用来生成遵循指定场景结构和人物动作的实时战斗展开. 配对可视化显示角色的外形和代词中的空间安排如何被所生成的框架所反映,而参考图像则指定了所期望的外观. 这些例子说明该模型在不进行额外培训的情况下能够适应环境、性格外观和运动控制等新的组合。 不同的培训数据和对性能的适应性面具支持在整个推出过程中的视觉一致性。

blocks.en: Furthermore, Fig. 5 (b) illustrates how Wizard’s agentic framework maintains and updates game states and enforces combat rules. We showcase a core rule: when either character’s health reaches zero, the controller resolves the character’s death, ends combat, and displays the outcome. The framework also allows additional gameplay rules to be flexibly incorporated.
blocks.zh: 此外,图5(b)说明了Wizard的代理框架如何维持和更新游戏状态并强制执行战斗规则。 我们展现了一个核心规则:当任一角色的健康达到零时,控制者会解决角色的死亡,结束战斗,并显示结果. 该框架还允许灵活地纳入额外的游戏游戏规则。

blocks.en: 5.3 Open-ended Creative Gameplay
blocks.zh: 5.3 开放式创意游戏

blocks.en: Wizard’s generalization capabilities enable diverse, open-ended gameplay, giving players control over both characters and their surroundings. As shown in Fig. 6 (a), players can transform characters during gameplay by providing a reference image of the desired appearance. This allows character appearance to become an interactive part of the gameplay experience rather than a fixed initial choice.
blocks.zh: 向导的通俗化能力可以使游戏游戏游戏多样化,开放,让玩家控制角色及其周围环境. 如图6 (a)所示,玩家可以通过提供所希望的外观的参考图像来转换游戏游戏中的角色. 这使得角色外观成为了游戏游戏体验的互动部分,而不是固定的初始选择.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 (b) demonstrates scene manipulation, including inverting the environment and introducing new scene elements through agent-controlled visual proxies. These examples extend user control from character animation to the geometry and layout of the game world. Character transformation and scene manipulation can also be combined within a single gameplay scenario, as illustrated in Fig. 6 (c). Together, these capabilities allow players to create scenarios by composing character and environment changes, extending the range of experiences supported by the same underlying framework.
blocks.zh: 图6 (b)显示场景操纵情况,包括倒置环境,通过代理控制的视觉代理引入新的场景元素. 这些例子将用户控制从人物动画扩展到游戏世界的几何和布局. 如图6(c)所示,字符转换和场景操纵也可以在单一游戏剧情中合并. 这些能力共同使玩家能够通过组合性能和环境变化来创造出情景,扩展了由同个基础框架所支持的经验范围.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions and Discussions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: However, Wizard still has some limitations. First, its reliance on a motion library makes it difficult to find compatible motions for characters with uncommon body structures. Second, consistency between the scene proxies and the generated video may decline over longer rollouts. Future work will focus on supporting more flexible, realistic character motions that better reflect actual gameplay and maintaining consistent scene appearance over long rollouts. These improvements will bring agentic video generation closer to fully playable, closed-loop game worlds with greater player freedom and more precise, nuanced control.
blocks.zh: 然而,"巫师"仍有一些局限性. 首先,它依赖一个运动库,使得很难为身体结构不寻常的字符找到相容的运动. 第二,场景代理和生成的视频之间的一致性可能因较长的推出而下降. 今后的工作将侧重于支持更灵活,更现实的性格动作,以更好地反映实际游戏,并在长期推出后保持相容的场景外观. 这些改进将使代理视频生成更接近于完全可玩,可闭锁的游戏世界,玩家拥有更大的自由度和更精确,更细微的控制.
